sources.citation: Cosemans and Frehen (2021), Salience Theory and Stock Prices
sources.boundary: Authors' 2017 methodology read; monthly US evidence, not a daily A-share replication.

sources.citation: Liu, Stambaugh and Yuan (2019), Size and value in China
sources.boundary: Authors' 2018 manuscript read; preferred value factor is EP, not vendor BM; the paper's smallest-30% exclusion was not imported.

sources.citation: Cattaneo, Crump, Farrell and Schaumburg (2020), Characteristic-Sorted Portfolios

interpretation.returns: Across-date mean of selected names with observed outcomes, minus 31 bp per cohort. Overlapping cohorts are not compounded account NAV or verified execution.
interpretation.mse_improvement: 1 - model MSE / purged training-mean M0 MSE; negative is worse. Mean-target MSE gate requires at least 1% improvement.
interpretation.selection: Full eligible A-share universe scored; unchanged predeclared liquid S pool used for Top20. No sector restriction. Missing outcomes retained in stress comparisons.
interpretation.basic_data: Historical vendor size and 1/PB proxy; vendor-vintage reconstruction, not archival accounting PIT.
interpretation.d1_minus_a0: New information-block comparison under the same Ridge recipe; pruning prevents an exact nested-regression attribution.
interpretation.d2_minus_d1: Method-and-representation comparison; D2 does not consume all legacy C2 inputs.
interpretation.next_step: Close this bounded study. No automatic new search, parameter adjustment, website replacement or model promotion.
